idea: Build QuickBite, a student meal planner app with dorm recipes and cooking timers

screens.purpose: Capture user's available dorm cooking appliances, weekly grocery budget, and dining hall meal swipe quota to personalize recipe recommendations.
screens.userGoal: Set up profile quickly to get tailored dorm-safe recipes and budget tracking without manual filtering.
exitActions: Tap Save Profile -> Navigate to screen_dashboard
Tap Skip Setup -> Navigate to screen_dashboard with default profile
screens.layoutStructure: Single-column scrollable form with multi-select appliance toggle grid, slider for budget, numeric stepper for meal swipes, and fixed bottom CTA button bar.

componentInteractions.trigger: Single tap on appliance icon card
componentInteractions.action: Toggles selection state (active/inactive) and dynamically updates recipe match preview count
componentInteractions.feedback: Haptic click pulse, 2px emerald green border highlight, and checkmark icon toggle

componentInteractions.trigger: Drag slider thumb or tap preset buttons ($30, $45, $60)
componentInteractions.action: Adjusts target weekly grocery spend limit
componentInteractions.feedback: Real-time value counter update with dollar indicator shifting from green to amber over $50

screens.loadingState: Skeleton shimmer boxes replacing appliance grid cards and balance inputs while loading user defaults.
screens.emptyState: Default state shows pre-selected standard microwave and mini-fridge options with $40 budget.
screens.errorState: Inline validation banner 'Please select at least one cooking appliance' if all are deselected on submit.
screens.successState: Confetti micro-animation with green check toast 'Profile Saved! Customizing your meal plan...'
screens.mobileConsiderations: Minimum 56x56dp touch targets for appliance cards; thumb-accessible sticky bottom CTA button.

screens.purpose: Serve as daily command center for meal planning, swipe/budget balancing, and rapid launch into cooking timers.
screens.userGoal: Instantly see what I can cook right now based on my ingredients, swipes left, and available appliances.
exitActions: Tap Recipe Card -> Navigate to screen_recipe_detail
Tap Grocery Icon -> Navigate to screen_grocery_list
Tap Log Swipe -> Increment swipe counter inline
screens.layoutStructure: Top status bar with swipe/budget counter -> Horizontal scrolling 'Quick Eats' launchpad -> Vertical scrollable daily meal schedule feed -> Bottom tab navigation.
uiComponents: Quick Start Timer Floating Action Button

componentInteractions.trigger: Single tap chip (e.g. Air Fryer Only)
componentInteractions.action: Filters dashboard recipe feed to matches using specified appliance
componentInteractions.feedback: Chip background fills with primary brand color, inactive chips dim to 50% opacity

componentInteractions.trigger: Tap minus button or swipe left
componentInteractions.action: Deducts 1 dining swipe from remaining weekly count
componentInteractions.feedback: Numerical decremental animation with haptic confirmation bump

screens.loadingState: Pulsing skeleton layout for balance summary and horizontal recipe cards.
screens.emptyState: Card stating 'No meals planned for today' with a button 'Generate Quick Meal Plan'.
screens.errorState: Toast alert at top: 'Could not update meal swipes. Tap to retry connection.'
screens.successState: Badge animation on swipe counter when logged; recipe cards highlight recommended badge.
screens.mobileConsiderations: Swipeable cards with pull-to-refresh for recipe feed; edge-to-edge full width layout for mobile focus.

screens.purpose: Provide comprehensive step-by-step dorm-optimized recipe instructions, required equipment check, and ingredient scaling.
screens.userGoal: Verify I have all equipment and ingredients ready before starting the cooking timer.
exitActions: Tap Start Cooking -> Navigate to screen_cooking_timer
Tap Back Button -> Return to screen_dashboard
Tap Add Missing to Grocery -> Append to screen_grocery_list
screens.layoutStructure: Sticky top hero image with appliance badge overlay -> Scrollable content area with segmented tabs (Prep Info, Ingredients, Steps) -> Fixed bottom bar with 'Start Guided Cooking' CTA.
uiComponents: Recipe Hero Header with Wattage Tag

componentInteractions.action: Marks item as present in dorm stock; strikes through line item text
componentInteractions.feedback: Subtle green checkmark animation and text dimming

componentInteractions.action: Launches Guided Appliance Cooking Mode with active step preset
componentInteractions.feedback: Full-screen scale transition into dark-mode timer view with success haptic vibration

screens.loadingState: Hero photo skeleton pulse with gray blocks for ingredient checklist lines.
screens.emptyState: Message: 'Recipe detail unavailable offline unless previously saved.' with Save button.
screens.errorState: Full-screen retry prompt: 'Failed to load recipe details. Check internet connection.'
screens.successState: Checkmark indicators on all ingredients when user taps 'Select All Ready'.
screens.mobileConsiderations: Large touchable checkboxes (48x48dp); collapsible tip modules to save vertical screen space.

screens.purpose: Full-screen high-contrast cooking mode featuring multi-stage timers, appliance-specific alerts, and step-by-step guidance.
screens.userGoal: Follow step-by-step cooking instructions with precise timers without screen turning off or food burning.
entryPoints: Dashboard Floating Action Button: Quick Timer
exitActions: Tap Complete Cooking -> Navigate to screen_dashboard with meal logged
Tap Exit Cooking -> Prompt confirmation alert -> Return to screen_recipe_detail
screens.layoutStructure: Dark high-contrast mode header -> Large central circular countdown timer -> Current appliance instruction card -> Bottom step navigation controls (Pause, Next Step, Stir Alert).
uiComponents: Appliance Action Alert Callout (e.g., 'Stir Bowl Now')

componentInteractions.action: Pauses or resumes countdown timer and audio chime state
componentInteractions.feedback: Button icon toggles smoothly with tactile audio click sound

componentInteractions.trigger: Timer reaches designated mid-point step (e.g. stir microwave noodle)
componentInteractions.action: Pauses countdown, triggers loud notification tone and vibration pulse sequence
componentInteractions.feedback: Flashing coral border and bold full-width alert prompt

screens.loadingState: Immediate renders without external fetch using pre-loaded recipe steps from screen_recipe_detail.
screens.emptyState: N/A - Direct screen transition with populated state.
screens.errorState: System banner if wake-lock fails: 'Keep screen awake manual toggle enabled.'
screens.successState: Triumphant sound chime, full-screen green glow with text 'Bon Appétit! Meal Completed!'
screens.mobileConsiderations: Keep-awake screen lock enabled automatically; giant touch targets for hands covered in food/water; extra-loud alarm sound triggers.

screens.purpose: Consolidated store shopping list organized by aisle, with a mini-fridge volume capacity indicator and budget tracker.
screens.userGoal: Buy only necessary ingredients that fit within my $30-$50 budget and mini-fridge physical space limit.
exitActions: Tap Clear Checked -> Remove completed items from list
screens.layoutStructure: Top sticky mini-fridge capacity meter and price summary card -> Aisle-grouped checkable list accordions -> Bottom floating add item input field.

componentInteractions.trigger: Tap checkbox or swipe item row right
componentInteractions.action: Toggles completed state, updates total estimated cart cost, and decrements fridge capacity meter
componentInteractions.feedback: Item strikethrough, light haptic feedback, price summary updates immediately

componentInteractions.trigger: Type item name and tap '+' or hit Keyboard Enter
componentInteractions.action: Appends new item under 'Uncategorized / General' section
componentInteractions.feedback: Item smoothly slides into top of list with brief highlight animation

screens.loadingState: Skeleton shimmer list with category headers loading placeholder items.
screens.emptyState: Empty bag graphic with text 'Your mini-fridge list is empty! Add ingredients from recipes.'
screens.errorState: Alert banner 'Could not sync list across devices. Showing local cached list.'
screens.successState: Budget bar glows emerald green when overall cart total remains within weekly user budget.
screens.mobileConsiderations: One-handed bottom entry bar for fast input at supermarket; swipe-to-delete gesture for fast list cleanup.

navigationFlows.trigger: First app launch or re-configuring user profile from settings

navigationFlows.flowName: Recipe Selection to Guided Cooking Flow
navigationFlows.trigger: User chooses a recipe on dashboard and starts cooking process
User needs missing ingredients for planned dorm recipes

globalRules: All touch targets must maintain a minimum standard size of 48x48dp (56x56dp preferred for cooking timer controls)
Optimistic UI updates applied for item checking, counter changes, and state toggles for zero latency feel
Screen wake-lock lock must be enforced during active timer screen_cooking_timer execution
High contrast ratios (WCAG AAA) mandatory for high-visibility use in dim dorm rooms or kitchen corners
Full offline availability for stored recipes, timer presets, and local grocery lists

sharedComponents.name: Header Hero Card
sharedComponents.description: Standardized summary top card featuring metric indicators, active filters, or high-priority progress status.

sharedComponents.name: Appliance Badge Chip
sharedComponents.description: Visual pill indicator showing required cooking appliance icon and microwave wattage info.

sharedComponents.name: Interactive Item Checklist Row
sharedComponents.description: Row item with check box control, item title, visual subtitle detail, and optional swipe-to-delete action.

designRequirementsForStitch.typographyGuidelines: Sans-serif typography (Inter or System UI), bold 28pt page headings, 20pt section headers, 16pt body, 14pt list items, and 48pt timer display numbers.
designRequirementsForStitch.spacingAndGrid: Strict 8pt spatial grid system using 8, 16, 24, 32, 48px padding and margin tokens across all screens.
componentVariantsNeeded: Primary Button (Default, Hover, Active, Disabled, Loading Spinner)
Appliance Selection Card (Default Unselected, Hover, Selected Active, Disabled Unusable)
Checklist Item Row (Default Unchecked, Checked Strikethrough, Swiped Action State)
Timer Display Module (Stopped, Active Running, Paused Flash, Mid-Cook Alert Flashing)
motionAndMicroInteractions: Smooth slide-up modal sheet transitions (250ms cubic-bezier ease-out)
Tactile button press scale feedback (0.96x compression on tap)
Progressive arc animation for countdown timer sweep (1000ms smooth updates)
Haptic light vibration pulses on checkbox taps and heavy vibration pattern on cook complete chimes
